name: dsh-hot-installer
description: Hot-install, hot-remove, hot-update and replay-protected profile bundles for DeepSeek Harness: install once, restart once, and every later `dsh plugin add` / `remove` / `update` takes effect live — no restarts, no stale rows, no page errors, and hand-edits of cordis.patch.yml can no longer drop hot-installed rows.
